title: Stamps read by byte range equal the full files
claim: A 64 by 64 pixel stamp cut from a frame by byte range holds the same values as the same pixels of the fully downloaded file.
test: Three frames in detectors 2, 4 and 5 were downloaded whole and opened with astropy. The byte ranges a stamp needs were recorded and decoded on their own. Image values were compared bit for bit, flag words value for value.
pass_rule: No pixel differs in any of the three frames.

title: Six small tables give the wavelength of any pixel
claim: Interpolating the small table stored in every frame of a detector gives the same wavelength and bandwidth as the reading of the frame's spectral coordinates by astropy.
test: 200 pixels in each of the six detectors: the corners, the centre, whole pixels and positions between pixels.

title: One tile of the index lists the frames at a position
claim: Looking up a position in one tile of the frame index gives the frames that the image search of the archive lists there.
test: Position RA 330.84, Dec -56.79: the lookup in tile 6_35 against the answer of the archive search for a circle of 0.0001 degrees around the position.
pass_rule: The two lists are equal, apart from frames whose edge passes through the search circle.
tolerance: 1 frame, whose edge passes 0.24 arcsec from the position
